title: 🏡 If my Gen Z kids asked me how to buy a home this year… here’s what I’d say.
description:
🏡 If my Gen Z kids asked me how to buy a home this year… here’s what I’d say.

Start by getting pre approved so you know your numbers and avoid surprises. Don’t stress too much about interest rates—focus on a monthly payment you’re comfortable with. You can always refinance later.

The key? Don’t wait for the “perfect time.” Start planning and take the first step.

📩 Message us “𝐁𝐔𝐘” and we’ll guide you through the process.
